A1.selection: screens of the 15 arrays (no process-development CMC screen), numeric yield, not Hiyama|1 C46

a.transformation: Schematic. A-D are molecules of the amide coupling array (SMILES in this sheet); A + B, A + C and D + B are product-forming pairs of that array (A1). No measurement is plotted.

b.transformation: A1 rows of the amide coupling array (Acylation|1). A pair is product-forming if its highest yield over the conditions is at least 0.10. Condition mean = mean yield of a condition over the product-forming pairs. Each pair's yields are fitted by least squares to intercept + slope x condition mean over its 94 conditions; condition pattern = 100 x (yield - fitted yield), in percentage points. Cell colour = pattern clipped to +/-30 points. r = Pearson correlation of two rows' patterns over the 94 conditions; mean r = mean of the six r within a group.

c.transformation: For each of the 15 arrays (A1 rows), condition patterns as in panel b over the array's product-forming pairs. Share of role 1 (2) = mean, over ordered pairs of pairs that share only their role-1 (role-2) molecule, of the mean product of the two patterns over the conditions measured for both, divided by the mean over pairs of the mean squared pattern. Molecular = role 1 + role 2. Noise = mean over pairs of the mean model measurement variance left in a pattern, k x max(0.07 x clip(fitted, 0, 1), 0.012)^2 x (1 - leverage), divided by the same mean squared pattern; k makes the model reproduce the Hiyama C43/C46 duplicate (C43 from A1, C46 from A3). Unattributed = 1 - molecular - noise (pair-specific interaction and any error outside the noise model). Neither shared = the role-share ratio for pairs sharing neither molecule. All x 100 (%).

d.transformation: Role shares of panel c (x 100, %). Owner = role with the larger share; owner fraction = owner share / (role 1 + role 2 share); owner >= 2x partner compares the owner share with twice the partner share, a negative partner share counted as zero. Electrophilic halide = the role named '... halide' (10 arrays). Likelihood owner: approved output of the Gaussian likelihood fit (anatomy.ml_components), not rerun here.

taken_from_approved_outputs: 95% interval of the median molecular share (Anatomy.json share.ci; 2,000 hierarchical resamples of arrays and molecules)
owner named by the likelihood estimator (Anatomy_arrays.csv ml_owner_role)
